findings.issue: In this copy the first test of 'while (currentNodes != 1)' is peeled into 'if stor128 != 1' with the remaining-levels loop duplicated in the else arm (with remainingLevels folded to 32), and the outer while and its inner for are merged into one 'while True' whose 'if s < y' branch is the inner loop and whose fall-through is the outer step; remainingLevels becomes 'a' off by one ('while idx < a - 1'). The same function is printed as properly nested 'while s - 1:' / 'while idx < s % 2 + s / 2' in getRollupExitRoot and in the other two copies.
findings.rule: A header reached by two back edges of different cycles (inner step, outer step) is two nested loops: split the header so the inner cycle gets its own while. Do not peel a loop's first test when the loop body is otherwise printed as a loop; keep one loop and one copy of its exit code.

findings.lines: e.g. getRollupExitRoot body: 'while s - 1:', '32 * (s % 2) + 16 * Mask(251, 1, s)', 'mem[_67] = 64 ... sha3(mem[_67 + 32 len mem[_67]])'
findings.issue: The loop test reads as 'while s - 1', the allocation size 32 * nextIterationNodes is split into 32 * (s % 2) + 16 * Mask(251, 1, s), and the keccak of the two packed words stays a hash of a memory range because the length 64 written at _67 is not forwarded past 'mem[64] = _67 + 96'; the same pair hash is shown as 'sha3(s, s)' where scratch memory is used.
findings.rule: Print a nonzero test of x - c as x != c. 16 * Mask(251, 1, s) = 32 * (s / 2), so 32 * (s % 2) + 16 * Mask(251, 1, s) = 32 * (s % 2 + s / 2). A write to mem[64] does not alias mem[_67] when _67 = old mem[64] >= 0x80; with the forwarded length, sha3(mem[_67 + 32 len 64]) is sha3(word1, word2).

notes: Via-IR build; the pack lists getRollupExitRoot twice (ABI and public), its four loops are counted once. P12 counts the three duplicated getRollupExitRoot copies in verifyBatches; the external call at the end ('call 0x0.mem[_580 len 4] with: args c', globalExitRootManager.updateExitRoot) targets the zero immutable (artifact, not separately reported).
summary: Faithful, with every source loop present; verifyBatches is bloated by three inlined copies of getRollupExitRoot, one of which merges its nested loops into a single while True with a peeled first test.
